title: Concept: X-DNS-Prefetch-Control explicitly enables DNS prefetching
description: The response sets X-DNS-Prefetch-Control to on, so the browser may resolve hostnames found in page links before a visitor follows them. Content that renders user-supplied links therefore produces outbound DNS lookups that reveal which hosts a visitor was shown.
risk: Rendered links produce outbound DNS traffic that discloses browsing intent; LOW severity because the disclosure is limited to hostname resolution.
